scope: Separate Exomem characterizations and exact compact-evidence retention; no paired parity or full graph-convergence claim.

warm.limitation: Single Exomem characterization, not paired acceptance median. Wrapper accepts graph-context available=true after sentinel commit; this can return empty seeds, so neither sentinel graph membership nor global graph convergence is separately established. Readiness raw retains call classification rather than full graph response.

expected_texts_verified: Introduction to the Tenth Anniversary Edition
limits: Single-product characterization, separate from paired parity acceptance.
Media startup records keyword recall and mutation admission; no full-corpus metadata/FTS membership proof is emitted by this driver.
Graph remains warming; full graph/lexical/embedding convergence is explicitly unproven.
Final persisted instrumentation records 3 rebuild attempts, 0 successful completions and 1 inflight. Its after_shutdown label is not proof the rebuild finished.
Graph elapsed counters include exited unsuccessful invocations and omit work still active; they are not total convergence time.
Zero topology paths/bytes applies only to the instrumented _sources_linking_to hook, not all graph work or all filesystem I/O.
Ledger occupancy/span/idle are invalid due UTC/client clock disagreement; connector overhead remains unmeasured.
Engine labels are retained; Python package versions are available, but a Tesseract binary version is not recorded.
Media result job states are enqueue-time snapshots; later public sidecar reads prove completed extraction.

clock_domain: Client/host duration measurements use time.perf_counter; graph instrumentation uses monotonic; UTC timestamps/ledger are a separate clock. UTC occupancy is invalidated, not adjusted. No cause for clock disagreement inferred.
